scope: Exploratory comparison added after the frozen encoder confirmation result was observed. No prompt, checkpoint, order, temperature or threshold selection. This does not retroactively make the competitors part of the training experiment.
protocol: All 360 states and 1800 decisions in the original option order. Existing frozen Tez Qwen prompt and Decider native independent=True, isolated score levels, eager bf16, T=1. Gold and IDs never enter inference. Preserve native four-decimal rounding and normalize. Reject input truncation. No calibration fitting.
compute: Laptop under shared run_heavy.py lock, four CPU threads, unchanged thermal governor, two sequential workers with at most six minutes each. Quality only, not a latency benchmark. No additional cloud spend.
analysis: Validate every probability vector, decision ID, option count, label and argmax. Report per-operation/domain accuracy, all failures, and paired state-bootstrap differences from the frozen rule-supervision model. Published scores and public-benchmark scores are not mixed with this corpus. No automatic runtime promotion.
